'''Morgan's Plot''' is a small decrepit church with a graveyard and [[Karazhan Crypt|crypt]] located in [[Deadwind Pass]]. It can be found just behind [[Karazhan]], and its graveyard serves as the respawn and [[spirit healer]] point for adventurers who die within the various [[Karazhan]] instances.

The chapel itself was once inhabited by two [[Unliving Resident]]s, and there was a third patrolling just down the hill. It is now inhabited by the specters of [[Anelace the Clairvoyant]], [[Hanvar the Righteous]], [[Pietro Paraveno]] and [[Hierophant Nerseus]], who watch over the church and keep the secrets of Karazhan hidden from the gazes of evil.
